model.bound: sum over displayed high symbols of independent maximum W[s][nibble]; actual ASCII count cannot exceed this
model.full_ascii_solver: pair-class relation intersection plus all-different CSP, invoked only when pair upper equals N

proposed_target.block: 19 ciphers x OFB/CTR x 2 keys x 2 IVs

limits: Panama and Arcfour eligibility is established by the pinned wrapper plus three full-length behavioral probes per key; their underlying algorithm C sources are not captured here, so this is not a source-level proof over every possible input.
The upper bound may exceed the true maximum because it ignores global consistency; below-threshold is conclusive, above-threshold is unresolved for 75 percent unless a stronger bound decides it.
The CSP decides only 100 percent ASCII when invoked; it does not solve the weighted 75 percent MaxCSP.
No Rev7 bytes are read or evaluated.
